Extracted requirements from spec 3.2 Integration with IPv6, RPL, and Test Vectors:
[MUST] Derivation must be identical across all implementations
[MUST] All implementations (Rust, C, Python) must produce identical outputs for given inputs
[must] Implementations must produce exact human_address for pubkey/seed
[recommended] Support round-trip: human address parsing to IID recovers original bytes
Test vectors: test/vectors/node-addresses.json is the independent oracle. Cross-refs: 04-network.md, 06-security.md, 08-nodes.md
